definitions.explanation: A comparative measure or percentage expressing the relationship between quantities.
As a counter, {割|わり} represents 10% of a whole. 1{割|わり} = 10%.

examples.japanese: ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割|わり}に→割に：16763_warini⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The quality is good for the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二割引|にわりびき}→二割引：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3{割|わり}2⟦{分|ぶ}→分：noentry⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧、⟦{全品|ぜんぴん}→全品：26366_zenpin⟧⟦{三割|さんわり}→三割：noentry⟧⟦{引|び}き→引き：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In this sale, everything is 30% off.

notes:
MULTIPLE USES:

1. As a unit (10%):
- 1{割|わり} = 10%
- {二割|にわり} = 20%
- ⟦{二割引|にわりびき}→二割引：noentry⟧ = 20% discount

2. In compounds:
- ⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧ (ratio, proportion, rate)
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (discount)
- ⟦{割高|わりだか}→割高：14734_waridaka⟧ (relatively expensive)
- ⟦{割安|わりやす}→割安：14735_wariyasu⟧ (relatively cheap)

3. As adverb (⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧/⟦{割|わり}に→割に：16763_warini⟧):
- ⟦{割|わり}と→割と：00420_warito⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ (relatively easy)
- ⟦{割|わり}に→割に：16763_warini⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (relatively expensive)

BASEBALL: Batting average is expressed in {割|わり}, ⟦{分|ぶ}→分：noentry⟧, ⟦{厘|りん}→厘：noentry⟧ (e.g., 3{割|わり}2⟦{分|ぶ}→分：noentry⟧ = .320)
